requirements.text: The contributor should see lint cover active Haskell sources, a malformed source rejected by the real command, duplicate Cabal dependencies removed, and the same public exports and command names after the change.

source-inventory-at-intake.text: The inventory maps the library, fifteen executables, and three test suites to their Cabal source directories. Naming's direct GHC test and drift sources are considered separately. The final review will explain any source directory deliberately excluded from lint.

evidence-limit.text: The original root build gate builds documentation and model packages, while selected registry jobs build off-chain targets. The new CI carrier builds the classified components used by required workflows and currently supported commands, plus the library and tests. Its inventory must name every unbuilt declaration and reject unknown or drifted omissions. A green result is not a package-wide build claim.

candidate-boundary-and-epic-completion.text: The current candidate inventories 69 Haskell files. Fourmolu checks 67 because two independent verifier files keep their intake bytes. HLint checks 41 files in nine directories; thirteen directories carry 214 measured hints. These gaps remain for final epic integration issue 278, which also owns coverage of other repository code. The first all-component build failed at connected verifier. Later direct builds failed at recovery rows and li zero one. The proposed ten built and nine unverified classification remains unapproved. Issues 172, 282 and 283 own the distinct command repairs; no other omitted command receives an inferred build result.

a-011-forward-correction-to-current-rele.text: The operator ruled the current release README outdated. Current and future instructions must distinguish commands verified against the integrated Lean source from retained legacy commands that are unbuildable or unverified. Already published archives cannot be rewritten. The assembled archive checker and a checksum-valid negative control must enforce the corrected promise. The deployment attach script's command dependencies must be classified; prose cannot make them build. The later main integration changed Lean exit-payment judgements; this maintenance carrier and release check do not verify those behaviors. The full exact-head gate and independent audit remain required.
